question: Can success arise from that very old mantra even over immense spans of time?
premises: Success is the desired outcome of a mantra.
The mantra in question is the very old one.
Even hundreds of crores of kalpas do not produce its success.
inference: Success does not arise from that very old mantra even over immense spans of time.
plain_english: Success does not arise from that mantra, even in hundreds of crores of kalpas.
